feature_interpretations.torque: Primary driver of mechanical overload failure; higher torque disproportionately escalates failure probability.
feature_interpretations.tool_wear: Cumulative cutting edge degradation; wear above ~200 minutes marks an exponential transition into high failure risk.
feature_interpretations.rotational_speed: Rotational velocity dynamics; lower RPM under high torque triggers power strain and thermal dissipation failure.
feature_interpretations.process_temp: Indicates thermodynamic thermal equilibrium; sustained process temperature differential signals cooling system breakdown.
